thread:
maya-infra: Heads-up — scheduling a small maintenance window on the 'saturn' GPU pool tonight 01:00-02:30 UTC. This is a microdrain + soft reboot pass for 4 nodes (saturn-21..24) to pick up NIC firmware fixes. No customer-facing API change, but we expect brief task reschedules while backfill happens.

raj: Thanks — what's the expected impact on queued batch jobs and Dedicated tenants?

maya-infra: Batch jobs will be drained and requeued by the scheduler automatically. For Dedicated tenants we will avoid evicting capacity unless needed; plan is to shift traffic to eu-pioneer and us-east-burst for the window. Should be transparent for hosted API but slight latency jitter likely for ~5-15m per node while KV caches warm.

emma: Can we avoid cold-starts for common prefixes? Any cache warmup steps we should run after the nodes come back?

maya-infra: Good call. We'll kick a lightweight prefix-warm job after each node is up. Script:
```bash
for NODE in saturn-21 saturn-22 saturn-23 saturn-24; do
  ssh ops@$NODE 'systemctl start infer-warmup && /usr/local/bin/prefix-warm --model=gptx-1 --keys=common-prefixes.json'
done
```
That should reduce burst latency by reclaiming KV cache hotspots.

liam: Who's owning the drain steps and rollback? I'm on-call tonight and can watch the drains.

maya-infra: @liam — thanks, you'll be primary. I'll run the node drain playbook remotely. @raj will coordinate routing & capacity. @emma will monitor latency/cost dashboards and start warmup jobs. ops-bot will post status updates.

ops-bot: Automated note — drain plan created: infra/drains/saturn-microdrain-6422109876. Will post lifecycle updates here.

raj: Routing plan: shift 20% burst to us-east-burst initially, then ramp another 30% if evictions exceed threshold. BGP routes + smart-routing policy already staged. If Dedicated throughput drops below SLA we pause drains and rollback.

maya-infra: Eviction threshold: >3% pod eviction rate OR sustained 95th latency >1.5x baseline for 10m. Rollback plan: cancel drains, rejoin nodes, and trigger cold-warm fallback model (gptx-1-small).

emma: I'll watch 95th, unit cost per token, and cache hit rate. If warmup fails we'll roll back after two failed warm attempts.

liam: Running drain on saturn-21 now:
```bash
kubectl drain saturn-21 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=15m
```
Started at 01:02 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deploy notification — no application deploys during maintenance window (01:00-02:30 UTC).

ops-bot: saturn-21 drained and rebooted — came back at 01:18 UTC. Started warmup job. (added :white_check_mark:)

raj: Load shift looks healthy. Latency spike ~8%, cache-hit recovery in progress. Continuing with saturn-22.

liam: saturn-22 drain started at 01:30 UTC. Two batch jobs requeued; priority tenants unaffected.

ops-bot: saturn-22 rebooted and passed health checks at 01:44 UTC. Warmup completed.

emma: Monitoring: 95th latency peaked to 1.2x baseline during saturn-22 drain, cost delta minimal. Good so far.

liam: saturn-23 drain started 01:55 UTC. Noticing slight egress burst — raj can you keep an eye on cross-region bandwidth?

raj: Watching egress. We've got headroom but will step down routing ramp if cross-region egress >70% of threshold. Current = 42%.

ops-bot: saturn-23 back at 02:12 UTC. Warmup failed first attempt, retried and succeeded on second run.

maya-infra: Nice. Only saturn-24 left. Plan: drain at 02:15 UTC, final verification then close window at 02:30 UTC. Any objections?

liam: No objections. Proceeding.

liam: saturn-24 drained and rebooted — node rejoined at 02:28 UTC. Completed warmup.

ops-bot: Maintenance summary — all 4 nodes drained, rebooted, warmups executed. Minor latency jitters observed, no SLA breaches, no Dedicated evictions. Full postmortem doc queued at infra/postmortems/saturn-microdrain-6422109876.

maya-infra: Thanks team. Quick follow-ups: (1) please attach warmup logs to the postmortem, (2) raj please snapshot routing adjustments, (3) emma please keep an eye for regression alerts over next 48h.

emma: Will do. Adding alert snapshots now.

raj: Routing snapshots uploaded. Cost impact: estimated +0.4% token-cost for the window due to cross-region routing — well within budget.

liam: On-call handoff note added. If anyone sees re-emergent cache misses ping me.

maya-infra: Closing thread. :rocket:
